items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Richard and I were just in the studio and he started fooling around playing with his bow and everything.

ctx.x: So I’m holding the “Heavy Sounds” C.D. The date for this recording, as you said earlier, June 19, June 20 1967, so this one was with Richard Davis. Was this put together just for this?

Yeah just for that one. It was originally supposed to be for Larry Coryell, Richard Davis, and a trio. You know, and Larry didn’t show up. For whatever reason he had. Richard and I were just in the studio and he started fooling around playing with his bow and everything. I said, “What are you playing?” and he said, “Oh ‘Summertime’” So he played it through and Bob Theil was in the recording booth, and he said, “Do that again we are going to record it.” So that’s how that piece got recorded.
Okay so let’s go back to, again, Jimmy Garrison is having some personal problems, which preclude him from continuing on in the Elvin Jones Trio. Who did you get to replace him?
